protocol_checks.vulnerability_mechanism: Confirmed. A user comparator can shrink a resizable ArrayBuffer during rqsort; js_typed_array_sort then reduces len and allocates/copies array_tmp at the reduced size while array_idx can retain pre-shrink indices, so reconstruction reads array_tmp[j] out of bounds. The fix's tests/bug1297.js reproducer exercises exactly this resize-during-sort path.
protocol_checks.atomic_bic: Confirmed as 878647e21dec1a101a5d7ced6134e70a8e2ffca8. This first PR #646 member adds RAB support and, in the same surviving public commit, changes typed-array sort to the live pointer, post-sort reduced len, and unchecked stale-index reconstruction that together enable the CVE mechanism.
